new_user_requirements.title: Use noncircular staged Bridge pilot and broader-activation prerequisites
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Exact applicable stages 1–5 plus explicit limited stage-6 entry authorization permit pilot start; missing stage 5 blocks it; pilot evidence cannot authorize stage 7 without a separate broader decision

new_user_requirements.title: Exclude every secret from model context while permitting only exact admitted owner-private protected-source formation/review
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Credential/private-key/recovery-secret values are always rejected; current exact participant/purpose/reader/processor/output-retention tuple can access protected education; wrong/revoked tuple and ordinary/client/export/Bridge contexts cannot; successor gets fresh readership

new_user_requirements.title: Separate plan-edition, enabled-profile and full-target acceptance
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Plan coherence never claims software exists; each release declares enabled/disabled scope and passes mandatory core plus applicable domain tests; genuinely disabled later modules neither appear passed nor block unrelated useful work; full target remains long-term

changes.change: Replace all-seven-before-pilot circularity with stages 1–5 plus explicit stage-6 entry, then stage-6 evidence and separate stage-7 decision.
Test stage-5 missing denial, valid stage-6 start without completion and denial of pilot self-authorization for stage 7.
Separate universally prohibited secret values from narrowly admitted protected education and enforce exact participant/purpose/reader/processor/output-retention tuples.
Handoffs reference protected originals; successors establish fresh readership and never inherit bodies or old grants.
Define plan-edition, enabled-profile and full-target acceptance objects; bind every profile to enabled/disabled scope, core invariants, applicable evidence, residuals and recovery.
Enable the useful local work/restart/restore loop while debates, competitions, production Bayesian models, extensions, commercial operations and Bridge are genuinely disabled until their own gates.
